description: Publish a saved view (or update an already-published one's allowlist) to a public, unauthenticated read-only link for clients or stakeholders — the API half only; there is no web page for the link yet. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES share_view"]

include_relation_api_names.description: Relation field api_names allowed to travel, as id/title/number chips only. Omit or [] = no related data leaves.

indexable.description: Allow search engines to index the link. Default false (noindex).

visible_field_api_names.description: Field api_names to expose. Omit for the view's own non-hidden fields. A rollup/formula/lookup must be named here explicitly or it never appears.

name: share_view
title: Publish a view to a public read-only link
